Meet Justin Brundage

Rooted in Science, Built for Service

Justin Brundage resides in Concrete, WA with his family, bringing a deep personal commitment to the success of our local schools. As a Software Test and Development Engineer at PACCAR Technical Center and an Eagle Scout, Justin approaches challenges with analytical rigor, practical problem-solving skills, and a dedication to community service.

Holding a degree in Material Science and Engineering, Justin combines technical expertise with a lifelong passion for teaching. He serves as the founder of Homeroom Heroes and lead developer of HelpTeachers.net, directly supporting classroom teachers and connecting donors to rural education needs.
